KRILLHUB / 001
FIELD NOTES / 001

One ocean. A tiny adventure.

Krillhub is an animated SVG illustration with dense, patchy swarms. Flat layers drift at different speeds for 2.5D parallax. Zooming reveals silhouettes and detailed krill without switching to a 3D scene.

This is an artistic interpretation of krill migration, not a scientific simulation of animal behaviour, water depth or a real ocean location.

Zoom from 20% to 2,400%: distant specks become silhouettes, then detailed SVG krill. Every speck keeps its identity. Brightness and population are illustrative, not measured data.
